note: R6.6 (F2-f) — the one banned-phrase source (CC1; experiments spec §9.4). `check-position.sh` reads `banned` and `record_banned` with byte-identical behaviour (C-25) and fails closed when this file is missing; `check-site.sh` applies all four lists to every visible string of the built site, including SVG text and attributes. Matching is case-insensitive and word-bounded, as in check-position.sh's BANNED scan. Entries are moved verbatim: `banned` is check-position.sh's fifteen; `record_banned` is §2.7's seven; `site_banned` is D1's five, F2's eight and §8.8's five phase-4 additions; `conditional` carries §9.4's four allowed forms. The `site_banned` phrases are ratified as listed in §9.4 (Q-F2-7 recorded).
